title: IT60113: Advanced Database Systems
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

A brief overview of relational databases. Advanced concepts in SQL Deductive
Databases. Spatial and Temporal databases. Active Databases. Object Oriented
Databases and Object-Relational Databases. Multimedia Databases. Distributed
Databases. Multi-dimensional and high dimensional data. Data distribution
properties of high dimensions. Nearest neighbor and range queries in high
dimensional databases. Approximate searches. R-tree and its variants.
Biological databases ? Searches in discrete data spaces.
